posts.meta_description:
60K likes, 433 comments - sobhitad on September 23, 2026: "Thank you, @elleindia 
“Style Icon” can feel like an intimidating title especially if you’re someone who sees style as a life-long dance 
To me, style is identity.
When you’re younger, you’re constantly collecting references - from films, magazines, people you admire, it’s like there’s an other-ness to it. As though it is elsewhere, meant to be borrowed. 
And then there comes a turn, without realising you start to look inward. 
You stop asking “does this look cool” and instead wonder “does this feel like me” and that can be a powerful shift. 
So this award means a lot, if it means that it is a celebration of my life’s story and how I get to interpret it. ♥️

Style @shaeroy, @rohitbalofficial 
Images @vedoughnut 
Glam @kaajee_rai".

66K likes, 477 comments - sobhitad on August 26, 2026: "I want to write about quiet rage, about the colour red, about grief that sits under that rage, about wild women, about modern horrors but I’ll park that for another time. I’ll let this Vogue imagery stay with you, when we were chatting about this cover shoot - the editor, the Vogue team and I.. it was clear that we were plotting to bring to life our collective fantasy about today’s Indian woman - a woman who chooses, on her terms. Revolutionary, when you really think about it. How many are really doing that huh 
@vogueindia".
